from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.LIGHTUP_DRAFT_PROMPT, prompt_custom.LIGHTUP_REVIEW_PROMPT])
        draft = await seq(problem)
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.LIGHTUP_FINAL_WORKER_PROMPT] * 3, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.LIGHTUP_FINAL_AGG_PROMPT)
        solution = await star(problem + "\n\nDraft candidate to verify:\n" + draft["response"])
        return solution["response"] or '```text\n"No solution, unable to solve the given Light Up puzzle."\n```', {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

- Bulbs can only be placed on empty cells.

- Every empty cell must be illuminated.

Output exactly one ```text code block and nothing else.
